observations.what: After submitting the work email, the invisible reCAPTCHA challenge appeared and on clearing it the page returned to the empty email form, so the email had to be entered a second time.
The signup flow showed a 'Welcome!' page telling me to check my email, but no verification email (link or code) arrived within about 5 minutes.
The 'Click here if you don't see the email' link did not resend anything; it opened a generic help-center article about trial emails not arriving.
The first signup page offered only work-email, Google, Microsoft and Apple options, with no visible way to proceed without receiving a mailed confirmation.
I did not try logging in directly with the new credentials after the email failed to arrive, so I cannot say whether the account was usable without verification.
